question: If Sin B = (15)/(17), what is the value of cos B (sec B - tan B)? Given that 0 pi/2
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expression = cos B (sec B − tan B)

⇒ (cos B × 1/cos B) − (cos B × sin B/cos B)

⇒ 1 − sin B

Substitute the given value sin B = 15/17:

⇒ 1 − 15/17 = 2/17

**∴ The correct answer is 2/17.**

Pythagorean Triplets

A set of positive integers (a, b, c) that fits the rule a² + b² = c² is called a Pythagorean triplet. Common sets are (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), and (8, 15, 17).

Basic Trigonometric Identities

The core identities used to simplify expressions are sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Trigonometric Ratios in Right Triangle

The side ratios are: sin θ = Perpendicular ÷ Hypotenuse, cos θ = Base ÷ Hypotenuse, and tan θ = Perpendicular ÷ Base.
